# Addison

## Doctors of Physical Therapy

### Welcome to DPT - Addison!

At our Addison physical therapy clinic, we provide compassionate, evidence-based care. Every patient receives individualized treatment from an expert clinician. Whether you’re recovering from injury or surgery or simply addressing a longtime ache or pain that keeps you from optimal function, we’re here to help you get better, faster! At this location, we also offer expert hand therapy.

No prescription? No problem! Direct Access means you get to choose where you go for treatment. We’ll work closely with you and your physician to develop an individualized treatment plan that works for you in your life. We can even refer you to a great physician, if needed.

We’ll also do everything in our power to accommodate your busy schedule – all of our locations have flexible hours to help you get the physical therapy you need, on your schedule.

Our friendly staff is happy to walk you through necessary paperwork and assist in any way possible, including insurance questions and scheduling. We’ll even call your insurance company for you to help you understand your benefits.

We can’t wait to see you!

### Find us Here

622 West Lake Street

Addison IL 60101

### Get In touch

Phone: 331-267-4023

Fax: 331-236-6496
